headline: The Andersons Reports Third Quarter Net Income of $46 Million
summary: The Andersons, Inc. announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting record third-quarter net income of $46 million.
why: The Andersons is an agribusiness company with operations in commodity trading, ethanol, and plant nutrient sectors.

impacts.name: The Andersons, Inc.
impacts.why: Quarterly earnings reports directly affect the valuation and trading of the company's equity.
